summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Portal Enhancements completed successfully. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 5 features verified working - Admin Workspaces, Workspace Detail, Chat Moderation, Shifts, and Sidebar Navigation.

- GET /api/admin/shifts/today - returns today's shifts grouped by workspace
- GET /api/admin/shifts - returns all shifts with pagination
- Workspaces link present and navigates to /admin/workspaces
- Chat Moderation link present and navigates to /admin/chat-moderation
- Shifts link present and navigates to /admin/shifts
- Stats cards: Total Workspaces (3), Active (3), Suspended (0), New This Month (2)
- Status filter dropdown (All Status, Active, Suspended, Archived)
- Workspaces table with columns: Workspace, Owner, Members, Messages, Shifts, Status, Actions
- Action dropdown with View Details, Suspend, Archive, Delete options
- Stats cards: Members (0), Messages (7d) (0), Shifts (Month) (1), Created date
- Tabs: Overview, Members, Activity Log, Admin Notes
- Admin Actions button for admin operations (Suspend, Unsuspend, Transfer Ownership, Delete)
- Workspace Owner section showing owner name and email
- Workspace Settings section showing Visibility, Join Approval, Chat Enabled
- Stats cards: Total Messages (0), Flagged (0), Today (0), Active Workspaces (0)
- Empty state 'No messages found' displayed when no messages
- Primary stats: Total Shifts (4), Today's Shifts (2), Active Now (1), Hours This Month (24h)
- Secondary stats: Unassigned (1), Cancelled (0), This Week (3), Total Clock-ins (0)
- Tabs: Today's Overview, All Shifts, Timesheets, Analytics
- Today's Overview shows shifts grouped by workspace with clock status badges
- All Shifts tab shows table with Shift, Workspace, Assigned To, Date, Time, Status, Actions
- Status filter and date range filters working
- Timesheets tab shows 'Timesheet Records' with empty state
- Analytics tab shows Top Workspaces by Hours, Top Workers This Month, Shift Status Distribution
